sections.title: Warm-ups
sections.blurb: The fluency you lean on when everything else gets noisy.

sections.title: Algebra
sections.blurb: Equations, functions, and the moves that unlock most ACT items.

sections.title: Geometry
sections.blurb: Shapes, angles, and space: draw it, then name it.

sections.title: Data & chance
sections.blurb: Read the story in a table, then weigh what could happen next.

fractions_decimals.label: Fractions and Decimals
fractions_decimals.blurb: Parts of a whole, switch freely between fractions and decimals.

ratios_proportions.label: Ratios and Proportions
ratios_proportions.blurb: A ratio is a fraction, so set up two equal fractions and cross-multiply.

order_of_operations.label: Order of Operations
order_of_operations.blurb: Parentheses first, then powers, then multiply/divide, then add/subtract.

basic_equations.label: Basic One-Variable Equations
basic_equations.blurb: Balance both sides until the unknown stands alone.

number_properties.label: Number Properties, Factors, and Divisibility
number_properties.blurb: Odd/even, primes, factors, multiples, and divisibility patterns.

measurement_units.label: Units, Measurement, and Dimensional Reasoning
measurement_units.blurb: Unit conversion is always multiplication or division: set up the fraction so units cancel.

algebraic_manipulation.label: Algebraic Structure and Symbolic Manipulation
algebraic_manipulation.blurb: Every algebra step is one of three moves: add/subtract, multiply/divide, or substitute.

linear_equations.label: Linear Equations
linear_equations.blurb: Variables to the first power only. Goal: isolate the variable.

functions_basics.label: Basics of Functions
functions_basics.blurb: f(x) is a machine: put x in, get output out. Composition = chain the machines.

linear_inequalities.label: Linear Inequalities
linear_inequalities.blurb: Same as equations, with one critical exception: flip the sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

systems_of_linear_equations.label: Systems of Linear Equations
systems_of_linear_equations.blurb: Substitution or elimination. Elimination is almost always faster on ACT.

exponent_rules.label: Exponent Rules
exponent_rules.blurb: Six rules. Memorize all six. They appear constantly.

polynomials.label: Polynomial Operations
polynomials.blurb: FOIL to expand, factor to simplify. Remainder theorem shortcuts long division.

factoring_polynomials.label: Factoring Polynomials
factoring_polynomials.blurb: Factor out GCF first. Then recognize the pattern.

radical_expressions.label: Radical Expressions
radical_expressions.blurb: Simplify roots the way you simplify fractions, clean the inside first.

quadratic_equations.label: Quadratic Equations
quadratic_equations.blurb: Three methods: factor, quadratic formula, completing the square. Know all three.

exponential_functions.label: Exponential Functions
exponential_functions.blurb: Growth and decay curves that multiply, not add.

sequences_series.label: Sequences and Series
sequences_series.blurb: Find the pattern, then the next term, or the sum.

right_triangle_geometry.label: Right Triangle Geometry
right_triangle_geometry.blurb: Pythagorean theorem + special triangles solve almost every right triangle question.

trigonometry_basics.label: Trigonometry Basics
trigonometry_basics.blurb: SOH-CAH-TOA is your best friend, so memorize it cold.

lines_angles.label: Lines and Angles
lines_angles.blurb: Parallel lines cut by a transversal create eight angles, but only two distinct measures.

triangles_congruence.label: Triangles and Congruence
triangles_congruence.blurb: Same shape and size: matching sides and angles tell the story.

circles_geometry.label: Geometry of Circles
circles_geometry.blurb: All circle questions come back to the radius and the central angle.

area_volume.label: Area and Volume
area_volume.blurb: Know your formulas cold. The ACT provides none of them.

geometric_transformations.label: Geometric Transformations
geometric_transformations.blurb: Slide, flip, and turn: the figure moves, the measures stay.

descriptive_statistics.label: Descriptive Statistics
descriptive_statistics.blurb: Mean, median, range, and standard deviation tell different stories about the same data.

basic_probability.label: Basic Probability
basic_probability.blurb: P = favorable / total. Know addition rule, multiplication rule, and complements.
